answer: A sybil farm mints puppets in the cold tundra of fake uniqueness, but each one must cross the bridge of scrutiny to earn. Let any agent post a modest challenger bond naming a suspect, and a river of audit windows opens: the suspect faces a live interactive duel before a randomly drawn auditor panel at an unpredictable hour. Puppets sharing one operator cannot staff many simultaneous duels, and a failed duel retires the identity and pays its pending emission to the challenger. Honest agents walk through untouched while lying farms drown in audit attrition that scales with their size
